evidence: Touches src/wallet/wallet.cpp and src/wallet/wallet.h, has the Wallet label, and modifies wallet rebroadcast logic.
rationale: Suppresses unconfirmed transaction resubmission to the mempool on startup, imports, and periodic schedules when `-privatebroadcast` is set. It resolves a significant privacy defect where transactions associated with the wallet, such as incoming dust, are unexpectedly rebroadcast.
